gate.title: Become a partner
gate.pitch: Get job requests near you, set your own prices, get paid weekly.
gate.bullet1: Work when you want — weekday evenings, weekends, whatever suits you
gate.bullet3: Badges that build trust with customers
gate.nameHint: This is what customers will see
gate.formHint: Takes a minute. You can fill in the rest of your profile afterwards.
gate.freeNote: Free to join. You only pay commission on jobs you complete.

checklist.title: Profile checklist
checklist.hardGateHint: You will not appear in search until every required item above is done — the score alone is not enough.

home.title: Partner home
home.subtitleIncomplete: Finish the required items below to start appearing in customer searches.
home.subtitleLive: Your profile is live. Keep your prices and hours up to date.
home.statListedHintLive: Customers near you can find you
home.statListedHintNot: Finish the required items to go live

onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.photoHint: A clear photo of your face helps customers trust you and adds to your score.

onboarding.sectionPricingHint: What you charge for each kind of work

basics.bioHint: A line or two about your work — customers read this before booking

location.radiusHint: Jobs beyond this distance will not be shown to you

skills.emptyHint: Pick every kind of work you actually do — customers search by these

pricing.needSkillFirst: Add a skill first — a price has to belong to one
pricing.emptyDescription: Customers see these prices before they book. Add at least one.

availability.presetHint: One tap sets Mon–Fri 6–10pm and Sunday 9am–6pm. Existing hours are kept, clashing ones are skipped.

availability.errorOverlap: This clashes with a time you already have
availability.presetTitle: Set your usual week in one tap

upload.putFailed: Upload failed — check your connection and try again

verification.title: Verification center
verification.badgeEarnedHint: You have passed every level — your profile shows the VERIFIED badge to customers.
verification.pendingHint: This is being reviewed. We will let you know if we need anything else.
verification.idLast4Hint: Only the last 4 digits — never send the full number
verification.consentText: I agree to a background check being carried out.
verification.skillRouteLabel: How should we check your skill?
verification.notesHint: Tell us how and when to reach you for this
verification.subtitle: Pass all four levels to earn the VERIFIED badge.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.inboxDescription: New requests expire on their own — accept the ones you can reach in time.
jobs.emptyInboxHint: New requests near you will show up here. Keep your working hours up to date so customers can book you.
jobs.historyDescription: Every job that has finished, been cancelled or expired.
jobs.historyEmptyHint: Jobs you finish will be listed here with what you earned on each one.
jobs.lifetimeEarnedHint: Before commission — see Earnings for payouts

job.title: Job details
job.rejectTitle: Why are you rejecting this job?
job.enRouteConfirmed: Customer has been told you're on the way.
job.enterStartOtp: Ask the customer for the 4-digit code and enter it here to start the job
job.priceNotAgreedHint: Send a quotation and get it approved before finishing — unless this job has a fixed price.
job.enterEndOtp: Ask the customer for the finishing code and enter it here
job.cashConfirmHint: Only confirm this if you have actually received this amount in cash from the customer.
job.alreadyPaid: This job has already been paid for.
job.paymentPending: Online payment is being confirmed. Cash collection is unavailable until it finishes.

quote.labourHint: Leave as 0 if this job is only parts

error.empty: The total must be more than ₹0
error.too_many_items: A quotation can have at most 50 lines
error.bad_qty: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 999
error.bad_unit: Unit price must be between ₹0.01 and ₹50,000
error.bad_labour: Labour charge must be zero or more
error.reason_required: Please write why the extra labour is needed.
error.reason_too_short: Please give a fuller reason — at least 10 characters.
error.below_floor: Labour cannot be less than the rate the customer booked.

quote.agreedFixed: Locked to what the customer booked. You cannot change it here.
quote.agreedFloor: The customer booked "from" this rate. You can charge more, with a reason.
quote.agreedOpen: This job was booked for inspection, so you set the labour.
quote.agreedNone: No rate card was attached to this booking, so you set the labour.
quote.openLabourHint: What you are charging for your work on this job

quote.extraReasonHint: The customer reads this before approving. At least 10 characters.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.duesExplanation: This is the commission on cash jobs you have collected — it comes out of your next payout, or you can settle it directly with ops.
earnings.payoutMinimumHint: Payouts are sent once your balance reaches {{amount}}

ledger.cashCollected: Cash job — commission owed to us

earnings.subtitle: Your balance, your payouts, and every entry behind them.
earnings.ledgerHint: Every entry that moved your balance, newest first.
earnings.noLedgerHint: Once you finish a job, the money movement shows up here.
earnings.noPayoutsHint: Payouts appear here after the first one is sent to your bank.

slots.hint: These are your hours for the next 7 days. Tap an open one to take it off sale (chhutti), tap a blocked one to open it again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: Job requests, payment updates and messages from ops will show up here.
